name: documents
description: Inspect, extract, validate, and preview DOCX files without an external Office installation.

interface.shortDescription: Read and preview DOCX files safely.
interface.longDescription: Inspect OPC and WordprocessingML structure, extract bounded document text, preview documents in the desktop app, and report preservation risks without rewriting the source file.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Document tool when the task requires deterministic DOCX inspection, extraction, or validation. User preview is provided separately by the desktop renderer.
